reviews.comment: Staying here for 8 months now. The food is much better than typical PGs in Gachibowli, especially Sunday chicken biryani. Wi-Fi has low latency which helps for online exams.
Hot water available 24/7 without fail. Rooms cleaned daily. Safe biometric entrance and peaceful study environment.
Management responds within a day if there is any plumbing issue. Rent is reasonable compared to nearby corporate towers.
Best girls hostel in Madhapur area. Warden aunty is super supportive and caring. Security is strictly monitored with biometric and CCTV. Food is like home cooking.
Very close to metro and bus stops. Rooms have good ventilation and high quality beds. Washing machines are always in working order.
Incredible amenities and international vibe. High-speed dual fiber lines never drop even during heavy rains. Expensive but 100% worth it if you have the budget.
The common lounge and gym are top notch. Food variety is unbeatable with both health bowls and regular Indian meals.
Very affordable for JNTU students. Within 5 minutes walking distance to campus gate. Food is simple South Indian, but unlimited and hearty.
Great value for money. Rent is just 5500 with food included. Roommates are all engineering students so group study is easy.
Quiet and green surroundings near Botanical Gardens. Great study desk in the room and gym is maintained well.
WiFi speed is 200 Mbps as promised. Sometimes traffic noise from main road, but metro connectivity is super convenient.
Just moved in this week. First impression is positive, food is tasty and warden was helpful.
Extremely safe and comfortable. Highly recommended for students who prioritize peace of mind.
Automated test verification review: exceptional hygiene and quiet environment.
